content.title: A turn back with every meter of altitude
content.text: It is our pleasure to satisfy your curiosity and answer any questions you may have about your stay with us at 1,550 metres.

content.firstoption: No specific room preference. I will take your recommendation.

boum eriro Suite: reclaimed wood ceiling, stone lights and wool headboard framing double bed with white linen bedding and cashmere blanket on plank floor
Bathroom of boum Suite with lime plaster walls, driftwood faucet, backlit mirror, reclaimed wood beam ceiling and glass rain shower
Stylish interior of eriro Alpine Hide – sculptural designer light beneath reclaimed wood ceiling, linen fabrics and mountain panorama through window, warm sanctuary
Private balcony lounge of boum Suite with upholstered daybed and wide view across green alpine meadows to summit silhouettes of Wetterstein
Eriro Suite living area with reclaimed wood ceiling, textured wool wall, sheepskin armchair before panorama window with terrace and view of conifer forests and mountain summits
Eriro Suite seating area with white linen cushions, wooden table and pendant light before artful patchwork wool wall beneath rustic reclaimed wood beam ceiling
Wisa Suite: reclaimed wood ceiling, natural stone wall and hand-woven dividers framing bed with white linen – sanctuary in honest materiality
Bathroom of Wisa Suite: hand-plastered vanity, driftwood faucet, backlit mirror, reclaimed wood ceiling – purist elegance meets craftsmanship
Cashmere blanket on wooden terrace of Wisa Suite at eriro with open view of Wetterstein massif, spruce forests and rock summits – alpine sanctuary
Winter suite with wooden floor, desk, fur armchair and floor-to-ceiling window with panoramic view of snow-covered Zugspitze mountain range
Sunlit lounge corner at eriro Alpine Hide with handcrafted bouclé wall paneling, chess set on wooden table and inviting upholstered sofa in natural tones
Glass-front fireplace with slate base and cream corner bench before panorama window to spruce forests and Wetterstein mountains, Marshall speaker at eriro Alpine Hide
King bed with white hotel bedding on spruce platform, raw stone objects as wall art, golden straw headboard paneling at eriro Ehrwald beneath patinated beam ceiling
Handcrafted vanity in bathroom of eriro Alpine Hide – fine care products, bronze faucet and wooden lattice panels in warm lighting mood
Larch wood balcony of eriro with woven bench, wool cushion and direct Zugspitze view across alpine meadows to rugged Wetterstein walls in atmospheric haze
Studio suite at eriro with slate fireplace plate, patinated barn boards, cream linen lounge and hanging limestone sculptures at Ehrwald
Cream daybed beneath honey-colored spruce rafters with woven furniture on balcony, Zugspitze view over spruce forest and alpine meadows at eriro Alpine Hide Ehrwald
Designed-through eriro suite with colonnade of spruce trunks, full-glass pivot doors to balcony and view of Wetterstein conifer forests
Loft suite at eriro with white bed on stone platform beneath recycled beams, round logs, glass room dividers and raw stone lamps at Ehrwald
